shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile in relief
animal figures carved on the face of a tall upright pillar
schematic outlined bodies with legs shown in profile
justification: Both surfaces show wild animals rendered in relief on the faces of tall upright rectangular pillars, with a low-relief quadruped in profile (legs and tail schematically outlined) and figures stacked in separate vertical zones. The strongest difference is that B carries a much richer multi-register programme — a row of animals at the top, a woven/zigzag band, birds with a disc, a small human-like figure and a long-necked bird — while A shows only a single three-dimensional predator descending head-down above one flat quadruped, with no birds, band or abstract motifs.
